observations: Photo 0 shows a white industrial sewing machine on a metal table with red feet, labeled 'Emel' on the front frame. The machine has a motor underneath and a presser foot. A metal stand with a thread stand is attached to the left.

Photo 1 shows the same machine from a side angle, with the 'Emel' logo visible on the front of the table and on the machine head. The motor is visible below the table. The table surface is white with red lettering on the right side.

Photo 2 shows the machine from a wider angle, revealing a second identical machine on the left side of the table. The table has red edges and the 'Emel' logo is visible on the front. The machine has a metal stand with a thread stand and a small motor on the left side.
The machine appears to be in used condition with some dust and minor wear. The table is made of metal with a white top. The environment is a room with a cracked wall and a bed in the background.
No power cord is visible in any photo. The machine is not shown in operation.

read_from: photo 1 front of table and machine head
photo 2 front of table and machine head

claims.claim: Fairly used Emel industrial sewing machine
claims.evidence: The brand 'Emel' is visible on the machine and table in all three photos. The condition appears used with some dust and minor wear, consistent with 'fairly used'.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine in operation, including the motor running and the needle moving.

risks.risk: The machine may have missing or damaged parts (e.g., motor, needle, presser foot).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the motor, needle, and presser foot from multiple angles.

risks.risk: The machine may have electrical issues or be unsafe due to lack of power cord or grounding.
risks.proof: Photo of the power cord and plug, and a close-up of the motor and electrical connections.

proof_requests: Video of the machine in operation.
Close-up photos of the motor, needle, and presser foot.
Photo of the power cord and plug.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
